scope: Same-process culling off/on exact single-sample main color with AO, floating normal/depth, AO and reflected target comparisons; all three LODs; front, rear, cockpit and overhead orthographic cameras; doors, windows, steering, wheels, aero, paddles, mirrors and spring travel
limits: Finite camera/pose coverage, not exhaustive whole-game validation
Rigid hero-vehicle meshes, posed Porsche meshes and rigid generated box/sphere parts are culled; shader-deformed foliage/water are unchanged
Conservative rejection retains uncertain/boundary cases; stereo bypasses culling
